The source has all six figures, but the proposal schema allows only one `group_values` entry per treatment group. It rejected the six separate entries as duplicates, so I can’t save the requested structure as submitted.

The pending proposal remains unchanged. I can revise it to one entry per group that preserves the Grade 3, 4, and 5 figures in that entry, or retain the separate rows as supporting evidence outside `group_values`.
